title: When I was little

grammar.explainAr:
للحديث عن عادة قديمة لم نعد نفعلها الآن نستعمل: used to + الفعل المجرد (دون إضافات).
مثل: When I was little, I used to sleep in a tiny bed.
examples: When I was little, I used to build castles with bricks.
Lina used to play with dolls.
My grandmother used to read stories to me.

sentences: I used to build castles with bricks.
Lina used to play with her doll.
I used to sleep in a tiny bed.
My grandmother used to look after me.
We used to make cakes together.
Do you remember when you were little?
